rules.rule_text: The final loan amount must exactly match the approved principal amount.
rules.supporting_quote: R-001 The final loan amount must exactly match the approved principal amount.

rules.rule_text: The final interest rate must exactly match the approved note rate. Any discrepancy requires a revised Closing Disclosure before funding.
rules.supporting_quote: R-002 The final interest rate must exactly match the approved note rate. Any discrepancy requires a revised Closing Disclosure before funding.

rules.rule_text: The amortization term must exactly match the approved term.
rules.supporting_quote: R-003 The amortization term must exactly match the approved term.

rules.rule_text: Escrow must remain enabled unless a later written underwriting condition explicitly waives it.
rules.supporting_quote: R-004 Escrow must remain enabled unless a later written underwriting condition explicitly waives it.

rules.rule_text: A Title & Settlement Services fee difference of up to $250.00 from the Loan Estimate is tolerable. A difference greater than $250.00 requires review and correction.
rules.supporting_quote: R-005 A Title & Settlement Services fee difference of up to $250.00 from the Loan Estimate is tolerable. A difference greater than $250.00 requires review and correction.

rules.rule_text: A final cash-to-close difference greater than $500.00 from the Loan Estimate requires review and a revised disclosure request before funding.
rules.supporting_quote: R-006 A final cash-to-close difference greater than $500.00 from the Loan Estimate requires review and a revised disclosure request before funding.

rules.rule_text: A borrower's middle initial may be omitted if the first and last names otherwise match.
rules.supporting_quote: R-007 A borrower's middle initial may be omitted if the first and last names otherwise match.

rules.rule_text: Standard postal street abbreviations such as Drive/Dr. and state-name abbreviations do not constitute a property-address variance when the street number, street name, city, state, and ZIP otherwise match.
rules.supporting_quote: R-008 Standard postal street abbreviations such as Drive/Dr. and state-name abbreviations do not constitute a property-address variance when the street number, street name, city, state, and ZIP otherwise match.
